description: This file defines the GeoZone model class for the OpenCart e-commerce system, handling retrieval of geographic zone data from the database.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Model class for accessing geographic zone data, including methods to retrieve individual geo zones and lists of geo zones.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific geo zone record based on geo zone ID, country ID, and zone ID.

methods.name: getGeoZones
methods.description: Retrieves all geo zone records from the database.
